You're auditing the Nxeon v2 customer portal (a Next.js app) at /opt/nxeon-v2, running locally at http://localhost:3021 (NXEON_SANDBOX=1 — this is intentional: Proxmox provisioning, Stripe card charges, and DB Studio's live SQL are stubbed, but every other code path is real and hits a real Postgres DB). This is a design fork of a production hosting platform, close to being promoted live, so this audit needs to find REAL bugs via REAL hands-on testing with Playwright — not a code read. Write any throwaway Playwright scripts inside /opt/nxeon-v2 (module resolution requires it) and delete them when you're done.

Login: admin@nxeon.local / iCwEt7PDdo0ne3YM (has existing services, NOT promo-eligible for hosting's first-month-free). For testing PROMO-ELIGIBLE flows, register a fresh throwaway account via /register (needs name+email+password fields all filled or submission silently no-ops) — a freshly registered account is unverified by construction, which matters (see below).

YOUR SCOPE: fully exercise /dashboard/deploy — the multi-step wizard for all 5 products (VPS Servers, Game Servers, Cloud Hosting, Business Email, Domains).

WHAT TO ACTUALLYDO, not just glance at:
1. For EACH of the 5 products, walk every step of the wizard to the payment step (don't need to actually submit payment). Check: plan/tier selection, OS picker (VPS) shows multiple versions per family (AlmaLinux/Debian/Rocky/Ubuntu) with Ubuntu latest preselected, region picker shows multiple regions, add-on checkboxes toggle correctly with a centered checkmark, term selector (Monthly/Annual/2yr/3yr) computes sensible prices, and for Cloud Hosting specifically: a monthly term shows real $0 for a fresh eligible account and does NOT demand a card for that $0 order.
2. Test the Game Servers catalog specifically: search box, pagination (Next/Previous), "Popular" badge legibility on EVERY visible tile (screenshot and actually look — a past bug had these illegible against bright screenshots), and click through several different game tiles to confirm their art loads (no broken image icons) or gracefully falls back to a placeholder icon.
3. CRITICAL — test in BOTH dark mode (default) AND light mode (toggle via the theme button in the topbar, or set localStorage nx-theme=light BEFORE loading the page via page.addInitScript, which is the more realistic "returning user" path), and test with BOTH the admin account (verified, no extra banner) AND a freshly registered account (unverified — shows an extra "Confirm your email" banner that pushes page content down further). Several past bugs (a decorative fixed-position background layer washing out the wizard's hero title) ONLY manifested with the unverified+light-mode combination specifically, because the extra banner shifts content into a problem zone — so don't skip that combination.
4. Check the browser console for ANY errors on every page load, especially React hydration warnings/errors (e.g. "Minified React error #418" or similar) — these are serious and have caused real bugs today.
5. Check for any visual overlap, illegible text, or elements bleeding outside their containers, at both a normal (1600px) and a very wide (1800-2000px) viewport width, since at least one bug today only appeared at wider-than-typical viewports.

Report back with a concise list of concrete, specific findings (file/component names where you can identify them, exact repro steps, and a screenshot path if you saved one to /tmp). If everything genuinely works, say so plainly — don't manufacture findings. Do NOT fix anything yourself — this is a discovery pass only, findings will be triaged separately.

content.text:
## Deploy Wizard Audit — Findings

Tested all 5 products end-to-end via Playwright against the live app at localhost:3021, using both `admin@nxeon.local` (verified) and a freshly-registered throwaway account (unverified), in dark and light theme, at 1600px and 1900px. Note: partway through, another concurrent session on this shared box stopped/rebuilt `nxeon-v2-web` (unrelated changes to `app/dashboard/services` and `app/dashboard/settings`) — I waited for it to finish and confirmed the deploy-wizard files were untouched before continuing.

### Real bugs found

**1. (High) VPS "Backup Plus" add-on is invisible in all displayed pricing, though it's charged correctly at submission.**
Checking "Backup Plus ($2.99/mo)" under VPS → Add-ons shows a "+1 add-on" badge but the bottom-bar total, the Payment step's Order Summary, and the "Pay $X and deploy" button all stay unchanged (e.g. $12.99 instead of $15.98). Root cause: `components/nx/order.tsx` (~line 328) sends `addonBackup: o.addons.includes("backup")` to the live `quoteOrder` preview, but `lib/order.ts`'s `orderQuote` prices backup off a separate `intent.backupTier` field ("FREE"/"PLUS"), which the preview call never sets. The real form submission (`components/nx/DeployView.tsx` line 1080) correctly sends `backup_tier=PLUS` — the code even has a comment explaining this exact FREE/PLUS-vs-boolean distinction — so the actual charge is right; only the customer-facing quote is wrong. Repro: Deploy → VPS Servers → expand Add-ons → check Backup Plus → total never moves, all the way through to the Pay button.

**2. (Medium) Cloud Hosting and Business Email totals for Annual/2yr/3yr terms are shown lower than what's actually charged.**
`app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx` builds `hostingMatrix`/`emailMatrix` as a rounded *per-month* rate, then `components/nx/order.tsx` multiplies that already-rounded rate back out by the term length — reintroducing rounding error the real charge (`lib/actions-hosting.ts`, `termPriceCents(plan.priceCents, term, annualPct)`, single rounding) doesn't have. Confirmed, reproduced to the Payment-step Subtotal/Pay button:
- Business Email Starter: Annual shows $19.08 (actual $19.10), 2yr shows $33.36 (actual $33.43), 3yr shows $42.84 (actual $42.98)
- Cloud Hosting Starter: Annual shows $28.68 (actual $28.70), 2yr shows $50.16 (actual $50.23), 3yr shows $64.44 (actual $64.58)

**3. (Low) Game Servers tier cards don't reflect the selected term.** In "Size your server," tier prices (e.g. Minecraft $4.99/$8.99/$15.99) stay fixed no matter which term chip (Monthly/Annual/2yr/3yr) is selected, even though the bottom-bar total (driven by the real `quoteGameOrder` server call) correctly discounts. `components/nx/DeployView.tsx` (~line 1590-1598) renders raw `t.monthlyCents` instead of a term-aware figure. Display-only; the actual quote/charge is correct.

**4. (Low/cosmetic) Debian OS version chips are out of order.** VPS → Server settings → Operating system → Debian shows versions as "13, 11, 12" instead of sorted order (13 is correctly preselected as latest). Ubuntu (24.04/22.04/20.04), AlmaLinux (9/8), and Rocky Linux (9/8) all order correctly — likely a `sortOrder` seed-data issue specific to the Debian `osTemplate` rows.

### Verified working (no issues found)

- VPS: 4 tiers, OS picker (4 families × multiple versions, Ubuntu latest preselected), 3-region picker, addon checkboxes toggle with a properly centered checkmark, Control panels/Applications tabs.
- Game Servers catalog: search, empty-state message, genre filters, all 19 tiles load real art (no broken images), "POPULAR" badges legible against every tile in both themes/widths. Pagination code exists (21/page) but isn't reachable with only 19 seeded games — not a bug.
- Cloud Hosting first-month-free: fresh eligible account + Monthly term shows a genuine $0 total and "Covered by your balance / No card needed" — no card demanded.
- Full 2×2×2 (admin/fresh × dark/light × 1600/1900) matrix on Service/VPS/Game screens: unverified banner renders and pushes content down correctly everywhere; no washed-out hero title, no background bleed, no overlap at any combination, including unverified+light+wide.
- Zero browser console errors or React hydration warnings across all 8 combinations tested.
- Domains flow stays inside the 5-step wizard and correctly discloses "Domain search is switched off in this environment — no registrar is connected" rather than erroring.

Two apparent issues I chased down and ruled out as test artifacts (not real bugs): a "Domains tile navigates away" false lead (my selector matched the sidebar's "Domains" nav link, not the service tile) and a fullPage-screenshot stitching artifact making the last game-tile row look covered by the sticky footer (scrolling confirms it isn't).

All throwaway scripts (`.audit-*.mjs`, `.auth-*.json`) have been deleted from `/opt/nxeon-v2`.
